julesThoughtProcess: I chose a vibrant cyber-teal to evoke clean energy and a glowing sky in a hopeful, highly-advanced setting, offering a stark but welcoming contrast against the 1-bit lines.
storyPanel: Up in the structural hydroponics bays, old metal beams cross with new vine-woven trellises. Elara and her silent maintenance drone take a breather. Sure, the irrigation pumps occasionally stall out, and the structural groans of the expanding city can be unnerving, but up here, it's peaceful. They look out over the sunlit scaffolding, sharing a quiet, companionable silence as they cultivate the green veins of an artificial world—a testament to life finding a way, together.
